test_docstring_options: test pybind11 docstring options by asserting function and class docstring behavior
test_disable_function_signatures: test that disabling function signatures removes docstrings from bound functions
test_custom_docstring: test that a custom docstring is applied to a bound pybind11 function
test_overloaded_docstrings: test docstring behavior on overloaded pybind11 function definitions
test_disable_user_defined_docstrings: test that disabling user-defined docstrings suppresses docstrings on classes and properties
